text:
maria: Heads up — console routing header rename (old: X-RouteHint -> new: X-Route-Intent) lands tomorrow. Concern: SDKs + console telemetry/quotas may mis-attribute. Anyone owning SDK mapping?
ajay: we added an internal shim at proxy layer but it's opt-in. If SDKs don't emit new header, console might show 'unknown' route in dashboards. :eyes:
lucy: Is the new header canonicalized? casing? current py sdk lowercases headers by default in requests lib.
py-sdk-owner: We can push a 0.13.1 patch that translates old->new. Quick Q: do we want to preserve both headers simultaneously or prefer only new one? Perf/regressions?
js-sdk-owner: Browser clients can't set arbitrary headers if customers use fetch from browser. We need a body fallback: `route_meta` JSON param. We'll coordinate.
ajay: Server side we added precedence: if new header present use it; else if body.route_meta present parse it; else fallback to legacy header. Example: `X-Route-Intent: {"route":"nlp-prod","affinity":"user:123"}`
product-ux: Dashboard mapping needs stable keys — if we accept both header formats it will create split metrics unless we normalize at ingestion. Can eng-platform add a normalization pass so console shows canonical route id?
eng-platform-bot: rollout plan posted in #eng-platform: dark launch for 24h -> compare attribution by sampling -> full flip. Link: https://go/internal/route-rename-plan
lucy: Propose SDKs include opt-in flag: `use_new_route_header=true` default false for minors; we'll internally flip to true with a major bump later.
py-sdk-owner: I'll cut patch today with dual-write (emit both headers). Also add telemetry tag so console can filter. Tests: unit + e2e against staging ingestion.
js-sdk-owner: I'll add body fallback and emit both when possible. For XHR clients we'll only fallback.
maria: Thanks. Let's ensure quota billing uses canonical route id at billing stage. @eng-platform-bot please coordinate the dark launch metrics and post sticky notes.
ajay: :thumbsup: deploying shim to canary now. ping if you see any weird split in console.
